summary: SCYNEXIS filed an 8-K reporting routine annual meeting results and a charter amendment to increase authorized shares from 23.75M to 65M (common from 18.75M to 60M). Items include director elections, ratification of auditor Deloitte, advisory votes on compensation and frequency, equity plan amendment, and the share increase. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. This is a standard proxy-result and charter update, not a special situation.
